title: Bounded Finite-Family Fourier Estimator Program
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\mathcal{F}$ be a finite family of subsets of the $n$ coordinates, let $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/2$ be a rational learning parameter, and let $M$ be a positive integer. Define the random-example learning program that estimates a sparse Fourier hypothesis over $\mathcal{F}$ using the bounded-family sample count for $\varepsilon$ and $M$.
hypotheses_covered: finite family $\mathcal{F}$ of subsets of the $n$ coordinates
